title: Live output
summary: The transcript follows and "Jump to latest" is right, but an ended session says "Nothing yet", two full-width bands eat 230 dp before any output, and the log type is too large to read as a log.

issues.what: Ended state: status "Session ended · output no longer on the host", then a disabled Follow switch, then "Nothing yet" — as if output might still arrive. There is no way forward.
issues.fix: KitStateView inline: "This session has ended" / "Its output is no longer on dev-pc." Action: "Open the conversation" (the chat keeps the history). Hide Follow when nothing can follow.

issues.what: A "● Live" row and a "Follow" switch row, each full-width with dividers, take the top 230 dp; the live dot is a pale-blue disc with no motion or label beyond "Live".
issues.fix: One KitStatusLine under the top bar: "Live · following" with a Follow toggle icon as its single action; in scrolled-up state the "Jump to latest" pill already does the work.

issues.what: The log is mono at body-large size, so a 40-character line wraps ("flutter test test/ui/ / offline_banner_test.dart"); regression row 16 fixed exactly this for setup (mono bodySmall, one line per line).
issues.fix: Reuse TerminalView(framed: false) with bodySmall mono; long lines scroll sideways; tool lines ("[tool: edit …]") in muted colour so the agent's words stand out.

issues.what: Regression row 22 (open): "Connecting to the session…" / "Nothing yet" forever for a worker that never started; nothing in the source changes the copy after 8 s.
issues.fix: After 8 s: "No output from fox yet" with "It may not have started · Check the agent" (opens the agent screen).

title: <agent name> (Agent · session {id})
summary: Still a dashboard: engine fields, paths and a cost line that is not this agent’s fill the top, it says "Working" and "waiting on one other step" at once, and the controls sit at the end of a long scroll.

issues.what: Above the fold: "ctx 63%", Provider "opencode", Model "openai/gpt-x", Harness, Working directory "/home/dev/shopfront/.gc/worktrees/polecat-fox", Branch "polecat/sync-engine", "w-sync". Principle 2 bans paths and engine words above Details, and this screen already has a Technical details fold at the bottom.
issues.fix: Top of the screen: the agent's name, one status line ("Working on Sync engine · 3 h"), what it is doing now (the Activity line) and the controls. Move Identity, Runtime and Tokens into the Technical details fold.

issues.what: Header "Working"; Runtime State "Working"; Current work "Sync engine · waiting on one other step"; Activity "Picking up w-sync" — three contradicting stories (also noted by the census workers).
issues.fix: Derive one state from the host: if the agent works, the current work line says "In progress"; the dependency line appears only while the dependency is open.

issues.what: "0 tokens · ctx 63% · $0.00 est." with the footnote "Tokens and cost are the whole team's today" — zero tokens at 63 % context is impossible, and a team-wide figure on one agent misleads.
issues.fix: Remove cost from the agent screen; show team usage once, on the home's Details. If the agent has its own figure, show that, labelled.

issues.what: Controls (Message, Nudge, Pause, ⋯) start at y ≈ 1800 on the top scroll position — below the fold, at the end of the page.
issues.fix: Pin Message as the bottom action (KitScreen pinned primary) with Nudge/Pause/⋯ in the top-bar overflow, or put the controls directly under the status line.

issues.what: Context 63 % is shown three times (header, Context use, Tokens row); State twice.
issues.fix: Once, in Details.

issues.what: The "Tools" summary is a bordered card with its own padding and a wrapped two-line summary: an ad-hoc card around a list row.
issues.fix: KitExpandRow "Read 2 files · edited 2 · 6 commands · 4 test runs" without a card.

issues.what: Title "Worker · fox" and "Supervisor · deacon" use the engine's generated names as identity (regression row 21 is about this).
issues.fix: Title: the role in the person's words with the name as a muted suffix only when two share a role.

issues.what: A manual refresh icon holds the top bar's one action slot although the screen follows the host.
issues.fix: Drop it (or move to overflow) and show freshness in the status line; use KitRefresh for pull.

title: Stop {agent}?
summary: A correct kit confirmation (error-toned, says what stops and what stays), let down by the engine name "fox" and "the host".

issues.what: Title "Stop fox?" while the list called it "Worker"; body "the host can wake it again later".
issues.fix: Title "Stop the worker on Sync engine?"; body "Its session ends now. The work stays; the team can start it again later."

issues.what: Cancel is "Keep going" here, "Keep" on the gate and phone sheets, "Cancel" on the merge sheets.
issues.fix: One cancel label for every destructive confirm ("Keep" for stop/delete, "Cancel" only for forms).

title: Restart {agent}?
summary: Clear and honest ("loses what it had in context"), with the same naming and "host" wording nits as Stop.

issues.what: "Restart fox?" / "picks its work up from the host".
issues.fix: "Restart the worker?" / "It forgets its current conversation and picks the step up again."

issues.what: Restart uses the same error-pink primary as Stop although nothing is removed; everything looks equally dangerous.
issues.fix: Tonal primary for Restart; reserve error colour for actions that discard or end work.

title: Message {agent}
summary: A tidy composer sheet, but a typed message is thrown away on swipe-down with no warning, and there is no sign of where the message goes or when the agent will see it.

issues.what: The source (_MessageSheet) holds the text in a local TextEditingController; the sheet is dismissible by drag or scrim tap and pops null, so the typed message is discarded silently.
issues.fix: Keep the draft per agent (oc.teamDraft.<profileId> or in-memory on the controller) and restore it on reopen, or confirm "Discard message?" when dismissing with text.

issues.what: Nothing says what happens next; a busy worker may not read it until its turn ends.
issues.fix: Hint line under the title: "fox reads it after its current step."

issues.what: Title "Message fox".
issues.fix: "Message the worker" or the role-first name used everywhere.

title: Reassign work to {agent}
summary: A picker that acts on one tap with no confirmation and labels every item with the engine's "bead" id.

issues.what: Tapping a row immediately calls assignWork (source: the sheet pops the id, _reassign sends it); moving work between agents happens with no confirmation, no undo, and nothing on the row says so.
issues.fix: Tap selects; a pinned "Give it to fox" primary confirms; after sending, a snackbar "Moved to fox · Undo" where the host allows.

issues.what: Supporting lines "Work · bead w-ready-1", "Work · bead w-ready-2"; hint "Ready work on this host".
issues.fix: Supporting line: the parent task and age ("Offline-first sessions · ready 12 min"); hint: "Steps waiting for a worker. The one you pick moves to fox."

issues.what: No empty state visible in source for zero ready items beyond the list.
issues.fix: KitStateView inline "Nothing is waiting for a worker".

title: Technical details
summary: Correctly folded technical values with copy buttons, but every value appears twice (curated label, then the raw lowercase key) and the sheet title jumps to headline size.

issues.what: Run id "fox" and name "fox"; Session "bl-5qc" and session "bl-5qc"; Pool and pool "gastown.polecat"; Provider status "active" and state "active".
issues.fix: Show the curated rows once; list only raw keys that have no curated row under a "Raw values" label, with the same label casing.

issues.what: "Pack —" has no copy icon, so its value column breaks the right edge the others keep.
issues.fix: Hide empty values, or reserve the icon slot.

issues.what: Sheet title is headline-large (like the run/host details) while the message and reassign sheets use title-medium.
issues.fix: One sheet title style across the team sheets (KitSheet title).

title: <gate title> (Decision / Confirmation / Free text / Gate / Run failed / Review ready)
summary: The answer flows are sound (options, Send pinned in the block, Approve/Deny, Close, Details folded), but every header repeats the kind three times with an interaction id, and the failed-task variant is a report with no primary way forward.

issues.what: Header: "Decision · 12m ago", title, then "Decision · interaction req-schema-1", then "Run Offline-first sessions". The kind appears twice, an id sits above the fold, and "Run" is the engine noun.
issues.fix: One kicker line "Decision · Offline-first sessions · 12m ago", then the question. The interaction id under Technical details.

issues.what: Run failed: "Recoverable: No — something needs changing first" and "Recommended action: Fix the failing tests on the host, then retry the run" — then offers "Restart or reassign", Close and ⋯ in one row. No primary; the advice is not doable from the phone and contradicts the offered action.
issues.fix: Title "Tests fail after the upgrade"; body the error in plain text (not mono); primary "Ask the team to fix it" (message the planner with the failure), secondary "Stop this task", Details for classification/raw error.

issues.what: Run failed shows the error sentence in mono and sections as label/value pairs (Classification "Test").
issues.fix: Error as body text; Classification under Details.

issues.what: Approval of a destructive-sounding request ("It rewrites the drafts table") uses a plain green Approve; Deny is tonal with pink text — the danger is on the wrong button.
issues.fix: When the request is flagged destructive, Approve takes the error tone and a confirm (the gate-sheet-confirm "Approve this destructive action?" exists — show it); Deny is a neutral tonal.

issues.what: Free text: the typed answer lives only in the sheet; source shows no draft keeping or dismiss guard.
issues.fix: Keep the draft per gate until sent, or confirm discard.

issues.what: Run failed actions "Restart or reassign · Close · ⋯" side by side.
issues.fix: Stacked hierarchy.

title: Approve this destructive action? / Deny this request? / Cancel this work?
summary: Right pattern and short copy; "Stop this work?" names the run in engine terms and "Deny" repeats the title.

issues.what: "The run stops and its open work stays as it is."
issues.fix: "The task stops; finished steps stay."

issues.what: Three stacked sheets (home → gate → confirm).
issues.fix: Confirm as a dialog over the gate sheet.

title: Ready to merge / Not ready / Merged
summary: A readiness checklist and diff size are the right content, but merge needs three confirmations, Approve sits under Merge as a second big button, and a pending review is shown as a red failure.

issues.what: Merging takes Merge → "Tap again to continue" (armed 8 s, button becomes "Confirm merge") → the "Merge into main?" sheet → Merge into main: three deliberate taps for one decision (source: merge_section.dart two-step plus sheet).
issues.fix: Keep one confirmation: the sheet (it states the branch and irreversibility). Drop the armed state.

issues.what: Two full-width buttons: filled "Merge" above tonal "Approve request". Approval is the step before merging, yet it is placed second; in the not-ready state Merge is a disabled grey slab whose reason is printed 300 dp below.
issues.fix: Show one primary for the next step: "Approve" while review is pending, "Merge into main" once approved. Disabled reason directly under the button, or hide the button and show the reason as the block's status.

issues.what: "✕ Review · waiting for approval" in error red: waiting is not a failure.
issues.fix: Pending checks use the waiting mark and neutral text; red only for failing tests or conflicts.

issues.what: "merge request gc-mr-14" in the header.
issues.fix: Header "Ready to merge into main"; the id under Details.

issues.what: The whole section is a bordered, tinted card inside the Overview, with its own inset rails (64 dp) unlike the rest of the page (32).
issues.fix: Sit on the page rails with a SectionLabel "Merge", no card.

title: Merge into {branch}?
summary: Error-toned and irreversible-aware, but it does not say what is being merged, and it is the third confirmation of the same act.

issues.what: Body "This cannot be undone from the phone" (no period) — nothing about which task, how many files or which branch.
issues.fix: "Merges Settings screen refresh (6 files, +312 −87) into main. You can’t undo this from the phone."

issues.what: Reached only after the two-tap arm on the section.
issues.fix: Make this the only confirmation (see merge section).

title: Approve this merge request?
summary: Clear copy ("Merging is a separate step"), but approving is not destructive and does not need its own confirmation sheet.

issues.what: A confirmation for a reversible, non-destructive approval adds a tap to the most common merge path.
issues.fix: Approve directly with a snackbar "Approved · Undo" (if the host allows withdrawing) or no confirm at all.

title: Changes
summary: A good compact diff summary with the work items that produced it; only long paths wrap awkwardly.

issues.what: Paths wrap mid-segment ("lib/settings/ / settings_screen.dart") and "+88 / -0" shows zero deletions.
issues.fix: File name as title, folder as muted supporting line; omit "/ -0".

issues.what: File rows are not tappable (no diff view).
issues.fix: If a diff exists, rows open it with a chevron; otherwise fine.

title: <run title> (Run · convoy | Run · formula)
summary: The task page has the right parts (title, status, one conversation link, what needs you, steps), but the top bar is empty above four tabs, the stage strip contradicts the status, and error/missing states disagree with their own buttons.

issues.what: On Overview the top bar is blank (only refresh and ⋯), then four tabs, then the title in display type; on the other tabs the title moves into the top bar. The place has no name until the eye passes the tabs.
issues.fix: Title always in the top bar (collapsing large title on Overview); tabs below it. Or drop the tabs: Overview with Steps inline and Agents/Timeline as rows.

issues.what: The four-stage strip "✓ Waiting · ● Working · ○ Reviewing · ○ Done" marks "Waiting" as a completed stage; on the merge fixture the status is "Done" with every stage checked while the text says "1 of 2 steps done" and review is pending.
issues.fix: Stages that are outcomes, not states: "Planned · Working · In review · Merged"; derive "Done" only when every step is merged.

issues.what: Missing state: body says "Refresh to check again" but the only button is "Back" and refresh is an unlabeled top-bar icon; icon is the cloud-off used for "can’t reach".
issues.fix: Body "It may have been closed or removed on dev-pc." Primary "Back to the team", tertiary "Check again". Use an empty/archive icon, not cloud-off.

issues.what: Error state has both the top-bar refresh icon and a primary Try again.
issues.fix: Hide the top-bar refresh while a state view offers Try again.

issues.what: "Working" is pale blue in the status line and green in the stage strip on the same screen.
issues.fix: One tone per state everywhere (AppStatusTone.working).

issues.what: Formula run overview is title, status, conversation link, strip and a Details row, then 1100 dp of black: the steps are on another tab although there are only 4.
issues.fix: Show steps inline on Overview for every run kind (the batch run already does).

title: Cancel this run? / Close this batch?
summary: Correct confirmation pattern, but it speaks the engine's nouns: a "batch" and a "run", where the rest of the app says "task".

issues.what: "Close this batch?" / "The batch closes on the host. Its open work items stay open for another batch." and "Stop this run?" — the home, the list and the missing state all say "task".
issues.fix: "Stop this task?" / "Steps in progress stop; finished work stays. You can’t undo this from the phone." Button "Stop task".

issues.what: Cancel label "Keep going" differs from other sheets.
issues.fix: Align cancel labels (see stop sheet).

title: Agents
summary: A plain list, but both rows are called "Worker" and the tab adds a whole screen for two rows the Overview could show.

issues.what: Two rows titled "Worker" with no name.
issues.fix: Name first ("fox · Worker").

issues.what: Two agents justify a row on Overview ("2 agents · 1 working ›"), not a tab.
issues.fix: Replace the Agents tab with an agents row on Overview, as the home already does.

title: Overview
summary: The celebration on a merged task and the stall line are good ideas, but a merged task still shows disabled Merge and Approve buttons, and a stalled task offers no action.

issues.what: Merged state: the merge card shows a greyed full-width "Merge" and "Approve request" under "Already on main". Two dead primaries on a finished task.
issues.fix: Merged state of the merge section: one line "Merged into main · e4c1a9f" with a copy action and "Review changes" tertiary; no Merge/Approve buttons.

issues.what: Stalled: "The host has not started an agent yet" with an hourglass and nothing else — no age, no expectation, no action (regression row 20 asked for age, next check and an action).
issues.fix: "No agent has started this step · 4 min" + "Usually 2–6 min" muted; after 6 min, tertiary "Start one now" (nudge the pool) and "Why?".

issues.what: Stop unconfirmed: "⚠ Stop run · Unconfirmed" outlined chip and "Try again" text button side by side under the conversation link, above the stage strip — a status shown as a button.
issues.fix: KitNotice under the status line: "Stop sent · dev-pc hasn’t confirmed it" with "Send again".

issues.what: Details open: "Steps · 2 done · 1 working · 0 held up" repeats the "2 of 4 steps done" status two rows up; "Usage · Team today · $0.00 est. · 0 tokens" is not about this task.
issues.fix: Details: started/updated times, branch, ids (copyable). Remove the step recount and team usage.

issues.what: Celebration plays on first open of a merged task (team_moments, KitMotion.celebration) — good; judge on device that it is skipped with Celebrations off.
issues.fix: Verify on device; no change if it obeys KitEffects.

title: Work
summary: Grouping by state is clear, but each step carries a cryptic one-letter circle ("W", "F", "–") and each group repeats its row icon in the header; the graph truncates names.

issues.what: Trailing outlined circles with "W", "F" or "–" are agent initials; nothing explains them and two Workers would both be "W".
issues.fix: Supporting line: "fox · 5m ago"; drop the initials circle. Unassigned: "Waiting for a worker".

issues.what: Every group header ("? Needs input · 1") carries the same icon as its only row.
issues.fix: Headers are text only (SectionLabel with count).

issues.what: Tab "Steps" but the sheet a row opens says "Work · bead w-sync" and the manifest calls it Work.
issues.fix: One word: "Steps" everywhere in UI; "bead" only under Technical details.

issues.what: "Waits on 1 step" is drawn in the accent colour, so it reads as a link.
issues.fix: Muted supporting colour; tone only for states.

title: Timeline
summary: A readable event list with filters, but the events are generic ("Sync engine updated" twice), an engine name slips in ("fox started"), and filters sit over an empty list.

issues.what: "Sync engine updated" appears at 13:36 and 12:21 with nothing saying what changed.
issues.fix: Say the change: "Sync engine · tests pass", "Sync engine · pushed", from the event payload; fall back to "updated" only when unknown.

issues.what: Empty: four filter chips above "Nothing has happened yet".
issues.fix: Hide the filters when the timeline is empty.

issues.what: The first row starts 8 dp under the chips (row 380 vs chip bottom 332) while rows are 96 dp apart.
issues.fix: 16 dp between the chip row and the list.

title: Technical details
summary: The right place for "convoy", "rig" and ids; minor craft: millisecond timestamps and a missing gap before issue_type.

issues.what: Started "2026-09-11 10:29:00.000" — milliseconds on a phone.
issues.fix: "Fri, Sep 11 · 10:29" like the work sheet, with the ISO value copyable.

issues.what: "issue_type" sits flush under the wrapped "Tracked work" value with no gap.
issues.fix: Same 16 dp gap between every raw value row.

title: Start a run
summary: A good pinned-action form with plain supervision choices, but a typed objective is lost on swipe-down, the planner row shows an engine id, and the planner-off state is a dead end.

issues.what: The objective lives in the sheet's TextEditingController (start_run_sheet.dart); dismissing by drag or scrim discards it silently. This is the app's main "delegate" input.
issues.fix: Keep the objective as a per-profile draft (oc.teamDraft.<profileId>) restored on reopen, and ask "Discard this task?" when dismissing with text.

issues.what: Planner-off: "The planner (Mayor) is off on this host. Wake it on the host or switch it to the full profile, then come back." with only "Host guide". The title still says "Give the team a task".
issues.fix: When the host creates work, go straight to the direct-task form (it already exists) with a one-line note; only when neither path exists show the state, titled "This team can’t take tasks right now".

issues.what: "Planner · Mayor gastown.mayor · Set on the host; the phone shows it and does not choose it." — an engine id and a row that informs nothing actionable.
issues.fix: Remove the row; if needed, one muted line under the button: "The team’s planner splits it into steps."

issues.what: Primary "Send to planner" under the title "Give the team a task", label "Objective".
issues.fix: Label "What should the team do?", button "Give it to the team".

issues.what: Supervision descriptions are two lines each; the three options push the pinned button to the bottom with no room.
issues.fix: One-line descriptions: "Asks before every decision" / "Asks on merges and failures" / "Asks only when stuck".

issues.what: Planner-off state inset at 64 dp inside the sheet while the title sits at 32 dp.
issues.fix: Same rails as the title.

title: Planning… (Mayor) / still planning / unconfirmed / refused
summary: A warm, honest waiting card with a moving drawing, but after 31 minutes it only says "Still planning — check the planner's output", and a refused task can only be dismissed, losing the objective.

issues.what: Refused: "The host refused the objective: The planner refused the message" with Planner output and Dismiss only (source: two tertiaries). The person's objective is gone unless they retype it.
issues.fix: Primary "Edit and send again" (reopens the start sheet prefilled), tertiary Dismiss; body gives the reason in plain words.

issues.what: Still planning (31 min): no elapsed time, no expectation, no action beyond reading raw output.
issues.fix: "Still planning after 31 min · usually 1–3 min" and actions "Message the planner", "Send again", "Cancel".

issues.what: Unconfirmed title wraps to two bold accent lines ("Sent, unconfirmed — check the planner's output before sending again"); refused title doubles the subject.
issues.fix: Title one line: "Not confirmed yet" / "The planner refused it"; the rest in the body.

issues.what: Only the first card's drawing loops (ambient: index == 0) — correct per §10.
issues.fix: Keep.

title: Agents
summary: A clean kit list, but two rows are both called "Worker", Idle is a colour-only grey blob, and the working agent leads with a play button glyph.

issues.principle: C2 · P1 one name per thing
issues.what: Two rows are titled "Worker"; the only way to tell them apart is the supporting line. Elsewhere the same agents are "fox" and "wolf" (agent screen title "Worker · fox", timeline "fox started", steps list avatars "F"/"W").
issues.fix: Title each row with the agent's name and role once: "fox · Worker", "wolf · Worker"; use the same label in the agent screen title, the timeline and the stop sheet.

issues.what: Idle agents lead with a solid grey 16 dp disc, working with an outlined play triangle, waiting with a question mark, suspended with a stop-square: four icon styles, one of them a filled blob, at one level.
issues.fix: Use KitStatusMark/KitRowIcon consistently: waiting-for-you question, working mark, idle hollow dot, stopped stop mark, all outlined at the same size.

issues.what: "Suspended on the host (1)" uses the engine's word and location.
issues.fix: "Stopped (1)" or "Asleep (1)" to match the home's Paused vs asleep wording.

issues.what: No top-bar refresh, empty or loading state is visible here; the screen ends in 1100 dp of black with nothing that says the list updates by itself.
issues.fix: A muted footer line "Updates by itself · checked 20 s ago" or KitRefresh pull-to-refresh.

title: AI Team
summary: The redesign is a real step up (one pinned primary, plain task rows, a Now line), but the same task appears twice, every working row spins at once, and the error states are a large empty top with a body that repeats its title.

issues.what: With one open question, "Offline-first sessions" is both the Needs you card and the first row under Tasks ("Needs you · 1 of 5 steps done"). The eye reads two items where there is one.
issues.fix: When a task is shown in Needs you, leave it out of Tasks (the Work tab card already does this: "leaving out the task the question already names"). Keep the count in the Needs you header: "Needs you · 1".

issues.principle: M4 · P5 one loop per screen
issues.what: Every "Working" task row leads with KitStatusMark(working), a CircularProgressIndicator, so the loaded home runs 2–4 spinners at once (12 in the long list), plus the planning drawing when a plan is pending, plus the waving mascot. Nobody on this screen is waiting on a spinner.
issues.fix: Use a still "working" mark on list rows (a filled accent dot or a static quarter-arc) and keep motion for the one thing the person waits on: the Now line or the planning drawing. Spinners only in a row the person just acted on.

issues.what: The Needs you card leaves ~100 dp of dead space between the last option ("Plain files") and "More": the reserved slot for the Send button that only appears after a pick. The mascot sits on the card border and collides with it.
issues.fix: Collapse the slot until an option is picked (KitReveal with child: null), and put the mascot beside the "Needs you" label, not overlapping the card edge.

issues.what: Error state: title "Can’t reach the team host", body "The team host can’t be reached. AI Team works over your Tailscale network or on this device." The body restates the title, "team host" is an engine term, and it offers no cause or next step besides Try again.
issues.fix: Title: "Can’t reach dev-pc". Body: "Check that the computer is awake and on Tailscale." Actions: Try again (primary), "Check the address" (tertiary, opens the host sheet). Raw error stays under Details.

issues.what: Two failure states for the same fact read differently: error says "Can’t reach the team host" with subtitle "On dev-pc · Not answering"; not-answering says "The team host isn’t answering" with a subtitle that does not mention it, and has no Details row.
issues.fix: One state, one set of words: "dev-pc isn’t answering", subtitle carries "· Not answering" in both, both keep Details.

issues.what: Error and not-answering states float the icon, title and button in the lower half under ~550 dp of empty black, left-aligned. It reads like the page failed to load, not like a designed state.
issues.fix: Anchor the state under the top bar with the KitStateView illustration slot (the "not answering" scene from standard §10), or centre the block vertically as a page-size KitStateView does.

issues.what: In the empty state the board appears twice: the top-bar board icon and a "View board" row.
issues.fix: Keep the row (it has a label) and drop the unlabeled top-bar icon, or keep the icon only once tasks exist.

issues.what: The Now line leads with an outlined play triangle, which reads as a play button, not as "working".
issues.fix: Use the working mark or the team agent icon for the Now line; reserve the triangle for actions.

title: Runs ({count})
summary: Search and filter work, but they do not filter the Needs you card, and scrolled content slides under a transparent top bar where it is cut through the middle of a line.

issues.what: Filtered state: the Now line has scrolled under the title and its second line shows cut in half ("no worker nas starteo") directly under "On dev-pc"; the top bar has no surface or scroll-under divider.
issues.fix: Give the top bar a solid surface with the scrolled-under elevation tint (Material 3 scrolledUnderElevation) or pin the Now line with the header so it never half-scrolls under the title.

issues.what: With the filter set to "Done", the full Needs you question card still sits above the results; with search open the query does not touch it either. The filter says Done, the screen shows an open question first.
issues.fix: When a search or filter is active, hide Needs you (or reduce it to one line "1 question needs you · Show") and show only matching tasks, with a "No tasks match" empty line when nothing matches.

issues.what: Warning Now line: “Price rounding in the checkout” has waited 34 min and no worker has started · Why?. "Why?" is the only affordance and it opens an engine explanation (routes, pools, patrol).
issues.fix: Say the consequence and the action: "Price rounding hasn’t started after 34 min" with a tertiary "Check the team" (opens the agents screen) and keep Why? as the second tertiary.

issues.what: The search field is a 52 dp outlined accent-bordered box plus a separate "All ⌄" filter row: two rows of controls before content, and a close X added to the top bar (three icons).
issues.fix: Put search in the top bar (SearchAnchor/SearchBar) with the filter as a trailing chip inside it; close with back.

title: Agents ({count})
summary: Replaced by a single agents row, which is right; the long task list it now shows repeats itself in every waiting row and lets supporting lines wrap.

issues.what: Each waiting row reads "Waiting for a worker · 34 min · no worker has started": the first and last clauses say the same thing, and the long ones wrap to two lines ("…no worker has / started").
issues.fix: One clause: "Waiting 34 min for a worker". After the threshold, "Not started after 1 h 2 min" in the warning tone. One line, never wrapping.

issues.what: Four spinners (one per working row) run at the same time over a list the person is only scanning.
issues.fix: Still working mark on rows (see team-home).
